kept.name: karpathy-llm-wiki
kept.reason: The pattern your system is built on: an LLM-maintained markdown wiki used in place of RAG. It's the direct baseline to compare against.

kept.name: agentic-memory-benchmark
kept.reason: Benchmark of 8 agent memory systems in which a curated markdown wiki scored above every commercial memory product. It's evidence for your approach, and its hallucination-check method is one you could reuse.

kept.name: third-brain-v5-wiki
kept.reason: A wiki knowledge layer for agents, with ChromaDB vector search running alongside the wiki. The entry already compares it to kb's lexical index and lists the lint ideas worth taking (staleness and contradiction checks).

kept.name: open-knowledge-format
kept.reason: Google's spec for typed markdown + YAML frontmatter knowledge bundles with links between them. Close to your record format, and it adds provenance and freshness fields.

kept.name: graphify
kept.reason: The inspiration for kb graph. Its confidence-tagged edges and clustering are ideas to compare against a deterministic graph.

kept.name: repowise
kept.reason: Uses a deterministic dependency graph with zero LLM calls, a generated wiki with hybrid search, and a stale-index warning on each answer. A close analog for coding agents.

kept.name: cartographer
kept.reason: Indexes a codebase into a local SQLite graph and hands agents scoped 'briefs' plus evidence-backed notes. A similar way of giving coding agents graph-based context.

kept.name: piyaz
kept.reason: A knowledge graph of tasks, decisions and records that serves context to coding agents in different shapes depending on task stage. A different design (a central server) for the same problem.

kept.name: mex
kept.reason: A structured markdown memory system for coding agents that checks for drift without LLM calls. Overlaps with kb and has a staleness-checking idea you could take.

kept.name: memstack
kept.reason: Agent memory stored in SQLite with semantic vector search. An example of adding embeddings to agent memory.

kept.name: sira
kept.reason: Improves BM25 lexical search by having an LLM enrich documents and queries, then rerank results. A strong alternative or complement to adding embeddings.

kept.name: chunkless-rag
kept.reason: An agent navigates the document's heading structure instead of searching chunked embeddings. A retrieval strategy that fits structured records with links.

kept.name: embeddinggemma-2
kept.reason: Small on-device embedding model with strong code scores and dimensions that can be truncated. A likely pick for adding semantic embeddings locally.

kept.name: claude-cookbook
kept.reason: Anthropic's guides on RAG, knowledge graph construction and context engineering. A reference for comparing retrieval patterns.

kept.name: obsidian-claude-second-brain-workflow
kept.reason: Hands-on example of a markdown/wikilink knowledge base that Claude Code keeps structured according to a schema in CLAUDE.md. Very close to your setup.

kept.name: prompt-assembly-cache-discipline
kept.reason: Says retrieved content should go at the end of the prompt to keep the cache valid. Directly relevant to how search results get fed to agents.

kept.name: context-graphs-trillion-dollar-elephant
kept.reason: Covers known hard problems for agent memory graphs: freshness, canonicalization, graph structure. Useful as a checklist to compare against.

kept.name: enterprise-context-management-cio-notes
kept.reason: Argues the real bottleneck is choosing which context to give the agent, not retrieving it. A useful lens on what search in a memory system is actually for.

kept.name: state-of-context-engineering-2026
kept.reason: Survey data on context graphs, siloed vector stores and stale context in agent systems. Vendor-backed, but useful for framing.

kept.name: mmeb-benchmark
kept.reason: Its V3 includes tasks on retrieving agent memory and tools. Possibly useful for evaluating your embedding search.

kept.name: karakeep
kept.reason: A knowledge store agents can use, with full-text search now and semantic search planned. Has hit the same move from lexical to semantic search.
